meaning: a person who is lazy and spends a lot of time sitting and watching television
literal_translation: persona perezosa que pasa el día frente a la televisión
example: My brother is a couch potato. He watches TV all weekend.
origin: Coined in the late 1970s in American English. It joins 'couch' (sofa) and 'potato' to describe someone who sits still.

wrong_meanings.meaning: a person who loves cooking vegetables
wrong_meanings.why_wrong: This is the opposite of the idiom, which describes someone who does not do much activity.
This is a literal meaning of 'potato' and has nothing to do with sitting or watching TV.

wrong_meanings.meaning: a very fast runner in a race
wrong_meanings.why_wrong: The idiom describes someone who is not active, so it cannot mean someone who runs fast.

explanation: 'Couch potato' describes a person who is lazy and spends a lot of time sitting on the sofa and watching television. It is an informal, friendly way to describe this habit.
